title: Harden persistence-isolation diagnostics and skipped backfill bookkeeping
outcome: The final persistence-isolation review found two low-severity diagnostic/bookkeeping gaps: remote or invalid overview-backfill candidates without an overview are selected and logged again on every startup, and the invalid-session persistence warning claims it is preserving a last good row even when a newly created invalid record has never been persisted. Make expected remote skips quiet or durably excluded, keep malformed-row isolation observable without repeated boot noise, and distinguish preservation of an existing row from rejection of an unpersisted invalid record.
acceptance: Repeated startups do not emit the same expected remote-proxy backfill skip warning; malformed candidates remain isolated and diagnosable; invalid-session persistence logs accurately distinguish an existing preserved row from a never-persisted record; focused regressions cover both cases.
disposal_reason: NOT PLANNED (backlog triage w-930e4d333f07, 2026-10-05; Greg's approval via Engram::Advisor #293). P3/P4, never started, no holder or children, untouched since before 2026-09-21, not reliability, data safety or pilot. The record is kept; reopen or re-file if it becomes relevant.
